kb.name: Tidewell Dispatch product overview
kb.content: Tidewell Dispatch is a field-service scheduling and dispatch product from Orrinmoor Systems. Dispatchers drag jobs onto a live board, and the routing engine orders each technician's day to cut drive time between jobs. It is built for heating, plumbing and electrical contractors with 20 to 500 field technicians. Native integrations: Quillfeather Books for invoicing and Hollins Payroll for timesheets. Technicians use the Tidewell Field app on iOS and Android. In Orrinmoor's 2025 study of 41,000 completed jobs across nine contractors, average drive time per job fell 18%. One dispatcher seat can manage up to 60 technicians on the live board.

kb.name: Case study: Bramblecote Heating & Air
kb.content: Bramblecote Heating & Air, a contractor with 140 technicians in three states, moved its dispatch to Tidewell Dispatch in early 2025. First-time fix rate rose from 71% to 84% within six months. Technician overtime hours fell 27% over the same period. The company kept the same four dispatchers while adding 22 technicians.

kb.name: Case study: Saltmarsh Plumbing Co
kb.content: Saltmarsh Plumbing Co, a 38-technician plumbing business, uses Tidewell Dispatch for emergency call-outs. Completed jobs per technician per day rose from 4.1 to 5.3. Missed appointment windows dropped to 3% of bookings.

kb.name: Security and compliance
kb.content: Orrinmoor Systems holds ISO 27001 certification, first achieved in 2024 and renewed annually. Its SOC 2 report is Type I; a SOC 2 Type II audit is underway and has not been completed. Customer data is stored in a Canada Central region or a UK South region, chosen by the customer at signup. Data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Card payments are processed by Pennyroyal Pay, so card numbers never touch Tidewell servers. Tidewell Dispatch is not HIPAA compliant.

kb.name: Crew plan pricing
kb.content: Tidewell Dispatch Crew plan pricing is $39 per technician per month, with a minimum of 10 technicians. Typical onboarding on the Crew plan takes three weeks. New customers can start a 14-day free trial with sample jobs before signing.

kb.name: Fleet plan pricing
kb.content: Tidewell Dispatch Fleet plan pricing is $64 per technician per month, with a minimum of 75 technicians. Typical onboarding on the Fleet plan takes eight weeks. Fleet customers get a dedicated onboarding lead and a 99.9% uptime commitment in the service agreement.

kb.name: Tidewell Field app
kb.content: Tidewell Field app. Technicians see their day's jobs, customer notes and job history on iOS and Android phones and tablets. The app works offline and keeps up to 7 days of assigned jobs on the device; changes sync when signal returns. Customers get an SMS with the technician's ETA 30 minutes before arrival. The app records GPS location only while a technician is clocked in. Technicians capture photos and the customer's signature on the job sheet.

kb.name: Integrations and API
kb.content: Integrations and API. Quillfeather Books syncs two ways: completed jobs become draft invoices, and payment status returns every 10 minutes. Hollins Payroll receives approved timesheets once a week, every Monday. Ravenmoor CRM connects only through Zapier; there is no native Ravenmoor connector. The public REST API allows 120 requests per minute per account, and webhooks fire when a job is created, completed or cancelled.

kb.name: Limits and unsupported uses
kb.content: Limits and unsupported uses. Tidewell Dispatch runs only as a cloud service and cannot be hosted on-premises. There is no desktop app for technicians; the Field app runs on phones and tablets only. Orrinmoor does not sell or install vehicle tracking hardware; location comes from technicians' phones. Tidewell does not calculate payroll or taxes. It does not manage parts inventory or create purchase orders for parts. The apps are available in English and French only.

kb.name: Rollout and support guide
kb.content:
Tidewell Dispatch rollout and support guide. This guide explains how Orrinmoor Systems moves a contractor from paper or spreadsheet scheduling onto Tidewell Dispatch, and how support works once dispatchers rely on it every day. It is meant for operations managers and office leads planning the switch. Every rollout runs in three stages: import, tune and launch. Read it alongside the plan pricing sheets.

Import stage. The customer's office lead exports the customer list, the technician roster and job history from the old system. Orrinmoor's onboarding team imports the last 24 months of job history so that the routing engine can learn typical job lengths for each job type. Skills and certifications are imported per technician, for example gas-safe or backflow-certified, so that jobs are only offered to qualified people. Orrinmoor asks for one named operations owner for the rollout.

Tune stage. During tuning the operations owner sets service zones, working hours and job-type durations. By default the scheduler never books a technician for more than 10 hours in a day and leaves a 15-minute buffer between consecutive jobs; both values can be changed per team. Orrinmoor then runs a one-week shadow period in which dispatchers schedule in both the old system and Tidewell and compare the boards each evening.

Support after launch. Support is staffed on weekdays from 7am to 7pm US Eastern time by phone and in-app chat. Severity-one incidents, meaning the dispatch board is down or technicians cannot receive jobs, have a first-response target of 30 minutes at any hour. All other tickets have a first-response target of four business hours. Accounts with more than 200 technicians are assigned a technical account manager (TAM) who runs a review every six months.

Records and leaving. Job records, photos and signatures are kept for five years by default, and the retention period can be shortened on request. If a customer leaves, Orrinmoor exports all job records as CSV and JSON files within 14 days of the request, and then deletes the customer's data within a further 60 days. Backups are encrypted and kept for 30 days.
